description: This file defines a static utility class 'PropertyUtility' within the 'Orleans.CodeGenerator' namespace. It provides methods for matching properties and fields, checking for compiler-generated symbols, and manipulating property names, primarily used for code analysis or generation tasks involving Roslyn symbols.

classes.name: PropertyUtility
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods for working with Roslyn symbols related to properties and fields, including matching and name normalization.

methods.name: GetMatchingProperty
methods.description: Finds a property symbol matching a given field symbol within a set of members.

methods.name: IsCompilerGenerated
methods.description: Checks if a symbol or property is marked as compiler-generated.

methods.name: GetMatchingPrimaryConstructorParameter
methods.description: Finds the constructor parameter that matches a given property, assuming the property is compiler-generated.

methods.name: GetMatchingField
methods.description: Finds the backing field for a given property symbol within a set of members.

methods.name: GetCanonicalName
methods.description: Converts a property or field name to a canonical form by trimming underscores and adjusting case.
